description: Automatic Building Energy Modeling (AutoBEM) is a model or code deposit deposited in DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) Repository by its authors Joshua New, Brett Bass (Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), Oak Ridge, TN (United States)). AutoBEM provides automated building energy modeling for quantifying energy, demand, emissions, and cost reductions for over 1 million buildings per hour. It creates a digital twin energy model of a building from a set of descriptors. Benefits include: Scale - has been used to simulate every building in the U.S. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
